sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal mature face with slight screen-left turn, short side-parted black hair and separate dark brows, thick black tapered moustache over the upper lip with otherwise smooth chin/cheeks and small closed calm mouth. Khaki/taupe broad-lapel military jacket with visible gold shoulder rank groups and buttons, an elongated small gold badge on screen-left lapel and a squarer gold badge on screen-right lapel; grey pointed shirt and taupe/olive tie. Preserve chest-up crop, gaze and soft upper-left light on complete pale cream-grey painted backing. Tiny insignia/rank relief cannot be resolved beyond its distinct gold shapes.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal mature face with slight screen-left turn, short black temple hair mostly covered by a white-crowned naval peaked cap, dark brows and thick black tapered moustache; no chin beard, small calm closed mouth. Cap has black band/strap and shiny black visor, central red shield-like gold-decorated badge/laurel group and small side gold fitting. Navy jacket with long red-gold collar tabs, gold shoulder details, pale grey-blue pointed shirt and black/dark tie. Retain actual chest-up crop, upper-left light and full cream-grey painted backing. Badge internal curving linework and tiny rank marks are pixel-limited, not guessed.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal mature face, thick dark eyebrows, large curled grey moustache and full wavy grey beard; hair covered by tall black turban with broad teal-blue crossed diagonal front bands and partly top-cropped gold central badge. Dark navy uniform jacket has gold shoulder details/small buttons and paired tiny gold lapel emblems, over pale white-grey pointed shirt and black tie. Preserve calm small mouth between moustache/beard, forward pose, shoulder/chest crop, soft upper-left light and full cream-grey painted backing. Exact tiny gold relief and individual beard strands are unreadable limits; preserve the teal-blue bands of this specific naval variant.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Three-quarter female face angled toward screen left, brown center-parted hair pulled back into a low bun, separate brown brows and gold-wire brown-tinted aviator sunglasses. Visible small near-vertical forehead scar above the inner end of screen-right brow and a thin bent/diagonal cheek scar descending below the screen-right lens; calm closed mouth and no facial hair. Olive-gold blouse with small round gold dots/buttons along screen-left V opening, burgundy/mauve sari draped over screen-right shoulder with broad gold border crossing the chest. Preserve actual crop/pose, leftward gaze and soft upper-left light on complete dark grey vignette backing. Tiny spectacle reflections, scar texture and blouse micro-marks remain pixel-limited.
